// What this is: TESTING profile only — lets colleagues use the app while it runs on the developer's laptop, until the real server is ready. Not used in production; the server uses appsettings.Production.json. See LAPTOP_PILOT.md for the setup checklist.
// Urls: Listen on the network (not just this machine) so colleagues can browse to http://<laptop-name>:5080.

PythonService.// BaseUrl: In this profile .NET and Python run on the SAME laptop, so localhost — and Python can stay bound to 127.0.0.1 (safer: port 8000 is not exposed to the network).

Auth.// Enabled: Windows sign-in test: ON asks Windows who each visitor is (real per-person identity, no login screens). If colleagues hit endless login prompts or errors, set this to false — everyone will then show up as the laptop's username, which is fine for feature testing.
